# web

The actions your AI can run on web through DozalDevs. They are the same tools a Dozal uses, run the same way. Run one with `run_app_action` (MCP) or the run-app-action command, app `web` and the action's slug below; `get_app_action` shows its inputs. A Viewer key runs only the actions that read.

| Action   | Reads or changes | What it does                                                                         |
| -------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `FETCH`  | reads            | Fetch one web page or document by its address and return its text                    |
| `SEARCH` | reads            | Search the open web for pages about a question and return titles, links and snippets |
